ad_library.summary: KehanSri runs 24 live Google ads behind one identity-verified account - the largest live Google ad count found in this sweep - and, unusually for the Hyderabad field, that spend lands on a domain they own. The site behind it is a 2019 WordPress build with real substance: eight named projects from 10 kW to 5 MW, a 4.9/131 Google rating, and published contact details. It is also carrying an active SEO-spam injection - Polish and German casino copy with quora.com outbound links sits on the homepage the ads point at, next to 156 posts all created between 9 and 13 November 2026. Fixing that, and the five buttons that still point at a staging host, is the cheapest work available to them.

defects.title: Injected casino spam on the homepage
defects.detail: The homepage carries long blocks of Polish and German online-casino copy with six outbound links, all of them to quora.com "unanswered" pages - pl.quora.com, de.quora.com and quora.com. Headings read "Najlepsze oferty na start dla nowych graczy", "Wszystko co warto wiedziec o nowoczesnych platformach hazardowych", "Faszination der digitalen Glucksspiele" and "Wie Sie seriose und sichere Plattformen im Internet erkennen", with link text like "kasyna z bonusem bez depozytu za rejestracje" and "neue online casino vodds". This is a WordPress SEO-spam injection, and it sits on the page 24 paid ads are sending traffic to.

defects.title: 156 posts created in five days, all inside that window
defects.detail: Every post in the sitemap is dated 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-13. That burst is the injection mechanism, not editorial output.

defects.title: The Google listing embedded on the contact page is a preschool
defects.detail: The contact page embeds a live Google Map with a 4.9 rating over 131 reviews - and the embed URL carries gcid:preschool, with the listing named "Ingenium Foundation School Gachibowli". The rating shown beside the solar enquiry form belongs to a school.

defects.title: Five 'Read More' buttons point at a staging host
defects.detail: Roof Top, Ground Mounted, Operation & Maintenance, Project Management and EPC & Development all link to www.wpstage.a2hosted.com/1411/kehanSri/ - a different machine from the live site.

defects.title: Header 'Get a Quote' and 'Contact Us' point at a staging path
defects.detail: Both go to kehansrisolar.com/kehanSri/contact-us/ - a staging subdirectory on the live domain.

defects.title: No H1 headline anywhere on the homepage
defects.detail: The page text read on 2026-11-14 has ten H2 headings and no H1 at all. The 'Clean-Pollution Free Power' line is letter-spaced into individual characters rather than marked up as a heading.

defects.title: No enquiry form on either page read
defects.detail: Neither the homepage nor the contact page carries a form. The only routes to the business are a mailto link, a tel: link and the two staging-path buttons.

defects.title: 24 of 26 homepage images carry no alt text
defects.detail: Four product images carry a literal alt="null"; the eight project images, repeated by the carousel, carry none at all.

defects.title: Theme demo testimonials are live
defects.detail: The four testimonials in the sitemap are named tiffany-brown-seven-media-group, max-freewind-seven-commerce, miriam-blackwood-seven-beauty-studio and richard-berrington-seven-education - the theme's placeholder content, never replaced.

defects.title: Default WordPress pages are live and indexed
defects.detail: /sample-page/ and /the7-web-master-home/ are both in the sitemap.

defects.title: Sizing table still quotes 300 Wp modules
defects.detail: The 'Know Your Solar Requirement' table prices 300 Wp and 320 Wp modules and shows 3 kVA saving INR 27,000 a year.

defects.title: A third-party domain serves a homepage image
defects.detail: handle.inspiroxindia.com/images/update.png is loaded by the homepage updates feed.
